name: GAWA All American Championship
epitaph: Switched hands at WrestleKrazy II when a title-vs-title stipulation handed it to the reigning Extremely Hardcore Champion; the promotion's own history credits Aswan Jaguar, The Prophet and The Dream as its three earlier champions.

name: GAWA Extremely Hardcore Championship
epitaph: Always defended in a gimmick match; switched hands at WrestleKrazy II in the same title-vs-title stipulation that cost Striker Phrost the All American belt.

name: GAWA European Championship
epitaph: Won and lost within the same three-way dance at WrestleKrazy II, then held through a disqualification finish engineered by a jealous former ally.

name: GAWA United States Championship
epitaph: Crowned in a ten-man battle royale at WrestleKrazy II; its first champion retained it a week later with a hidden pair of brass knuckles.
